source: client application note — VIN code identification (Tesla example)

title.en: VIN Code Identification in Modern Vehicles: A Tesla Example
title.zh: 现代汽车 VIN 码识别 —— 以特斯拉为例

subtitle.en: Multiple VIN methods across the vehicle — laser marking and high-performance labels chosen by application.
subtitle.zh: 全车多点 VIN 标识 —— 按应用场景选择激光刻印与高性能工业标签

seo_desc.en: How modern vehicles like Tesla identify the VIN across windshield, door jamb, structural body and battery packs — combining permanent laser marking with durable industrial labels for lifecycle traceability, regulatory compliance and anti-counterfeiting.
seo_desc.zh: 现代汽车（如特斯拉）如何在挡风玻璃、门框、车身结构件与电池包上标识 VIN —— 结合永久激光刻印与耐久工业标签，实现全生命周期追溯、法规合规与防伪。

overview.en: Application: Vehicle Identification (VIN). Industry: automotive manufacturing. Typical components include the windshield VIN, the door-jamb certification label, the structural (hidden) VIN and battery-pack labels.
overview.zh: 应用：车辆识别码（VIN）标识。行业：汽车整车制造。典型部位包括挡风玻璃 VIN、门框认证标签、车身结构件（隐藏）VIN 与电池包标签。

challenges.en: A vehicle's VIN must remain readable and traceable throughout its entire service life. Different vehicle locations are exposed to different environments, making a single identification method unsuitable for every application. Manufacturers must balance durability, regulatory compliance, serviceability and tamper resistance.
challenges.zh: VIN 需在整车整个使用寿命内保持清晰可读、可追溯。车辆不同部位所处环境各异，单一标识方式难以适配所有场景。制造商必须在耐久性、法规合规、可维护性与防篡改之间取得平衡。

solution_intro.en: Tesla uses multiple VIN identification methods across the vehicle. A laser-marked VIN beneath the windshield enables quick visual inspection, while a certification label on the door jamb provides regulatory information. Hidden VIN markings are permanently engraved on structural body components to prevent tampering, and battery packs and drive units carry durable labels for warranty and lifecycle traceability. Each marking technology is selected according to the application rather than applying the same solution everywhere.
solution_intro.zh: 特斯拉在全车采用多种 VIN 标识方式：挡风玻璃下方的激光刻印 VIN 便于快速目视检查；门框认证标签提供法规信息；车身结构件上永久刻印隐藏 VIN 以防篡改；电池包与驱动单元采用耐久标签，用于质保与全生命周期追溯。每种标识技术均按应用场景选择，而非千篇一律。

en.label: Windshield laser-marked VIN
en.text: A laser-marked VIN beneath the windshield enables quick visual inspection.

en.label: Door-jamb certification label
en.text: A certification label on the door jamb carries the required regulatory information.

en.label: Structural hidden VIN
en.text: Hidden VIN markings are permanently engraved on structural body components to prevent tampering.

en.label: Battery-pack traceability labels
en.text: Battery packs and drive units carry durable labels for warranty and lifecycle traceability.

zh.label: 挡风玻璃激光 VIN
zh.text: 挡风玻璃下方激光刻印 VIN，便于快速目视检查。

zh.label: 门框认证标签
zh.text: 门框处认证标签承载所需的法规与合规信息。

zh.label: 结构件隐藏 VIN
zh.text: 在车身结构件上永久刻印隐藏 VIN，有效防止篡改。

zh.label: 电池包追溯标签
zh.text: 电池包与驱动单元采用耐久标签，支持质保与全生命周期追溯。

items.label: 激光可打印 VIN 标签

value.en: Combining permanent laser marking with high-performance industrial labels improves vehicle traceability, supports regulatory compliance, simplifies maintenance and enhances anti-counterfeiting throughout the vehicle lifecycle.
value.zh: 将永久激光刻印与高性能工业标签结合，可提升整车可追溯性、支撑法规合规、简化维护，并在整个车辆生命周期内增强防伪能力。
